standard_prerequisites.name: Locality of the statement
standard_prerequisites.statement: The question is etale local on Y', and Zariski local on affine schemes, so it suffices to treat Y, Y' affine schemes.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the reduction at source lines 460-465.

standard_prerequisites.name: Chow's lemma for algebraic spaces
standard_prerequisites.statement: Every algebraic space X admits a surjective proper h_1 : X_1 -> X with X_1 a scheme (Cohomology of Spaces, declared as a tagged source pointer).
standard_prerequisites.use: It produces X_1 and X_2 at source lines 468-472.

standard_prerequisites.name: The scheme case of proper base change
standard_prerequisites.statement: The corresponding statement for schemes (Etale Cohomology, declared as a tagged source pointer).
standard_prerequisites.use: It gives the lemma for the two cartesian squares at source lines 473-492.

standard_prerequisites.name: The exact sequence for a surjective proper cover
standard_prerequisites.statement: For a surjective proper h_1 : X_1 -> X one has an exact sequence 0 -> F -> h_{1,*}F_1 -> h_{2,*}F_2 with F_i the pullbacks along X_i -> X (the author's lemma-surjective-proper, retained as context).
standard_prerequisites.use: It finishes the proof at source lines 493-497.

core_obligations: Reduce to Y and Y' affine schemes by etale and then Zariski locality (source lines 460-465).
Choose X_1 -> X surjective proper with X_1 a scheme and X_2 = X_1 x_X X_1, and apply the scheme case of the statement to the two cartesian squares with the sheaves F_1, F_2 (source lines 468-492).

Use the exact sequence 0 -> F -> h_{1,*}F_1 -> h_{2,*}F_2 (and its pullback, which is the same kind of sequence because X'_2 = X'_1 x_{X'} X'_1) to conclude, with the author's closing remark that some details are omitted (source lines 493-497).

proof_roadmap.step: Reduce to the affine case by etale and Zariski locality.
Apply the scheme case to the two cartesian squares built from a Chow cover X_1 -> X.
Conclude from the exact sequence of the surjective proper cover, omitting the remaining details as the author does.

difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-proper-base-change-f-star at source lines 450-457: for a proper f : X -> Y, its base change f' along g : Y' -> Y and any sheaf F on X_etale, one has g^{-1}f_*F = f'_*(g')^{-1}F. The author's proof at source lines 459-498 reduces to affine schemes: the question is etale local on Y', so one may replace Y' and Y by schemes V', V and then work Zariski locally, reaching the affine case; there one chooses a surjective proper h_1 : X_1 -> X with X_1 a scheme by Chow's lemma (a cross-chapter pointer), sets X_2 = X_1 x_X X_1, applies the scheme case of the statement (a second pointer) to the two cartesian squares with the sheaves F_i, and concludes from the exact sequence 0 -> F -> h_{1,*}F_1 -> h_{2,*}F_2 supplied by the chapter's lemma on surjective proper morphisms (retained as context), the same sequence holding after pullback because X'_2 = X'_1 x_{X'} X'_1. The author closes with 'some details omitted'; that remark is reproduced verbatim and the card supplies nothing in its place.
